newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 2.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average advanced 49.54 points or 0.65 percent to close at 7722.33 after a late-session rally.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index gained 1.60 points to 1,078.90.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5245/50 a dollar at around 0045 GMT, flat from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Tuesday at 2.5246/50.
* Shares of water utility Intan Utilities to debut, with offer price at 3.30 ringgit.
* Speculative plays on small-capitalised issues seen continuing, with foreign funds staying out again, dealers said.
* Berjaya Group net profit for year to April 30 was in the black with 81.17 million ringgit gain, versus a 7.24 million loss previously.
* Kumpulan Fima net profit for year to March 31, 1997 rose 16 percent to 40.77 million ringgit.
